Create one sophisticated luxury-fashion visualization of a Ready-to-Wear. Identity contract: A blazer has shoulder structures suspended from the collar rather than fixed conventionally to the body. Movement changes tension and shoulder position, shifting the silhouette between structured and draped states. The product remains a wearable tailored blazer with functional collar, lapel, body, and arm movement. Shoulder elements remain physically suspended and movement-responsive, not merely oversized conventional padding. Approved redesign: Use minimal visible silk tension lines at deliberate collar anchors with controlled shoulder drift. Use a long lean body with a restrained floating shoulder perimeter and sharply edited independent lapels. Keep matte olive wool quiet; concentrate charcoal quilted silk on mobile shoulder elements with tonal cords. Express strong proportions, material credibility, controlled novelty, intentional color, visual hierarchy, restraint, and plausible premium execution. The structural mechanism must remain operative and recognizable, never a decorative imitation. Do not change category, merge concepts, substitute a conventional product, or claim validated manufacturability or commercial readiness. One coherent product; no logos or text.
Variation 1 — architectural_clarity: Make the evaluated mechanism immediately legible through a disciplined, architectural silhouette and controlled luxury proportions.
Render one coherent product only, with no logos, captions, or text.
